description: This file is an assembly source file implementing a MIPS assembly routine for startup, initialization, and code relocation in a compressed kernel loader for Atheros AR7XXX/AR9XXX based boards within OpenWrt.

methods.name: ehb
methods.description: A macro for the 'EhEB' instruction sequence in MIPS assembly, used for synchronization.

methods.name: startup
methods.description: Entry point macro for the startup routine, performing CPU register clearing, relocation, cache flushing, BSS zeroing, stack setup, and jumping to the main decompression routine.
